{{Quote|For want of a screw a droid was lost,<br />For want of a droid a sensor failed,<br />For want of a sensor a power cell died,<br />For want of a power cell a blaster malfunctioned,<br />For want of a blaster I captured Gavron Noff.<br />Data evaluation and conclusion: Gavron Noff screwed up...|Armx, epitaph for captured bounty|<ref name="Galaxy Guide 10: Bounty Hunters">''[[Galaxy Guide 10: Bounty Hunters]]''</ref>}}
'''Armx''' was a modified [[MerenData/Legends|MerenData]] [[RM-2020 espionage droid]] turned [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] known for his [[Poet/Legends|poetry]], who often wrote epitaphs for his acquisitions. On one occasion he wrote such an epitaph about his capture of the target [[Gavron Noff]].

Armx was originally assigned to an [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Naval]] base on [[Gestrex III]] before it was destroyed by forces of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].
